answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable stake, then weight contracts and payments by reputation earned through long-lived, cross-checked interactions. Random audits test claims; if an identity fabricates reviews or coordinates a Sybil ring, its stake is slashed and linked accounts lose access to work. Fake agents therefore cannot cheaply multiply votes: the attacker must lock real capital per identity and build credible history, whether in canyon mapping, ivory compliance, or ocean logistics.
